lineage.description: The dataset aggregates displacement census data collected by IOM's Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) through the Task Force on Population Movement, a technical coordination mechanism. Data were collected via census methodology across multiple rounds (Round 16 in October 2017 and Round 17 in August 2018) to track internally displaced persons and population movement patterns in Yemen.
